options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain query parameter. Fetch system events with this domain. Possible values of domain are listed here /dna/platform/app/consumer-portal/developer-toolkit/events.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Specifies the maximum number of system health events to return per page. Must be an integer between 1 and 50, inclusive.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Specifies the starting point for the list of system health events to return. Must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.

options.name: subdomain
options.description: Subdomain query parameter. Fetch system events with this subdomain. Possible values of subdomain are listed here /dna/platform/app/consumer-portal/developer-toolkit/events.

options.name: summary
options.description: Summary query parameter. Fetch the latest high severity event.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
